Monitoring the osseointegration process in porous Ti6Al4V implants produced by additive manufacturing: an experimental study in sheep.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Skim only animal Exp. validation
Mehmet C Kayacan, Yakup B Baykal, Tamer Karaaslan, Koray Özsoy, İlker Alaca et al. Journal of applied biomaterials & functional materials 2018-04-01 10.5301/jabfm.5000385
单位: 1 Department of Mechanical Engineering, University of Suleyman Demirel, Isparta - Turkey.
通讯: Yunus E Delikanlı @ 4 Senirkent Vocational School, University of Suleyman Demirel, Isparta - Turkey. [推断]
相关性: 该论文研究了增材制造多孔钛合金植入物的骨整合过程，但缺乏力学测试和应力遮挡分析，与用户关注的力学匹配和疲劳性能关联较弱。
边界: This paper does not include mechanical testing (static or fatigue), stress shielding analysis, or stiffness matching quantification.
动机· 探索渐进多孔结构促进骨整合的机制
方法· 利用DMLS制造致密和渐变多孔Ti6Al4V植入物，植入羊颅骨12周
结果· 渐变多孔植入物比致密植入物有更好的骨整合
验证· 动物实验(SEM观察)
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the osseointegration process of transitive porous Ti6Al4V implants compared to massive ones.
Method· Implants were fabricated via direct metal laser sintering and surgically implanted into sheep skulls for 12 weeks.
Result· Transitive porous implants exhibited superior osseointegration with bone cell ingrowth into the inner region.
Validation· In vivo animal study with SEM analysis.

Different models for simulation of mechanical behaviour of porous materials.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Peripheral Background only simulation_case Exp. validation
S Muñoz, S M Castillo, Y Torres Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials 2018-04-01 10.1016/j.jmbbm.2018.01.026
单位: Department of Engineering and Materials Science and Transportation, University of Seville, Av. Camino de los Descubrimientos s/n, 41092 Seville, Spain. Electronic address: sergiomunoz@us.es.
通讯: S Muñoz @ Department of Engineering and Materials Science and Transportation, University of Seville, Av. Camino de los Descubrimie
相关性: 该论文研究了多孔钛的力学行为模拟，但与LPBF增材制造和疲劳性能无关。
边界: This paper does not involve LPBF fabrication, fatigue testing, surface roughness, or as-built morphology for biomedical implants.
动机· 理解多孔钛的力学行为以减轻应力遮挡效应。
方法· 建立三种2D有限元模型，分别采用规则圆孔、随机椭圆孔和半随机分布。
结果· 模型预测与实验数据吻合较好，弹性模量随孔隙率增加而降低。
验证· 与空间保持法制备的多孔钛实验数据对比验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To understand the mechanical behavior of porous titanium for reducing stress shielding in bone replacement implants.
Method· Three versions of a 2D finite element model were developed with different pore geometries: periodic circular, random elliptic, and semi-random distribution.
Result· The models predicted the macroscopic elastic modulus with good agreement to experimental data across porosities from 28% to 66%.
Validation· Validation was performed by comparing simulation results with experimental data from porous titanium fabricated by the space-holder technique.

R Dana Carpenter, Brett S Klosterhoff, F Brennan Torstrick, Kevin T Foley, J Kenneth Burkus et al. Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials 2018-04-01 10.1016/j.jmbbm.2018.01.017
单位: Department of Mechanical Engineering, University of Colorado Denver, Denver, CO, USA. Electronic address: dana.carpenter@ucdenver.edu.
通讯: R Dana Carpenter @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, University of Colorado Denver, Denver, CO, USA. Electronic address: dana.carpenter
相关性: 该论文直接比较了多孔PEEK和钛植入物在骨长入过程中的载荷分担和应力屏蔽，但缺乏LPBF制造和机械测试。
边界: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), and no surface roughness or as-built morphology characterization.

方法· 建立有限元模型模拟骨长入过程，比较两种材料的载荷分担。
结果· 多孔PEEK显著提高骨组织载荷分担比例和局部应变。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate how porous PEEK and titanium implant materials affect load sharing with bone tissue during osseointegration.
Method· Finite element models of porous implant-bone interfaces were created to compare load transfer under compression, tension, and shear with simulated bone ingrowth.
Result· Porous PEEK substantially increased the load share transferred to bone and induced higher local tissue strains compared to porous titanium.
Validation· The study is based on finite element simulations without experimental validation.

Virtual simulation of an osseointegrated trans-humeral prosthesis: A falling scenario.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Peripheral Background only simulation_case Patient-specific
A I Mirulla, L Bragonzoni, S Zaffagnini, M Bontempi, V Nigrelli et al. Injury 2018-04-01 10.1016/j.injury.2018.03.004
单位: University of Bologna, Italy. Electronic address: agostino.mirulla@unibo.it.
通讯: A I Mirulla @ University of Bologna, Italy. Electronic address: agostino.mirulla@unibo.it.
相关性: 该论文通过有限元分析评估骨整合假体在跌倒时的应力分布，与用户关注的AM生物材料制备和力学测试方向相关但缺乏实验验证和制造环节。
边界: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing, no porous structure or stiffness matching analysis, and no fatigue evaluation.
动机· 分析经肱骨骨整合假体在跌倒时的界面应力分布，预测失效风险
方法· 基于CT扫描的骨模型和CAD植入物模型进行线性有限元模拟
结果· 三角螺纹高度0.5mm时应力分布更均匀，但高度增至1mm可降低整体接触区应力
验证· 利用力平台记录健康受试者模拟跌倒的载荷数据
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate stress distribution at the bone-implant interface of a trans-humeral osseointegrated prosthesis under fall loading scenarios.
Method· Finite element simulation using patient-specific bone geometry from CT scans and CAD implant models based on the OPRA design, with load inputs from force platform recordings.
Result· A triangular thread with 0.5mm height yields more homogeneous stress distribution, while increasing height to 1mm reduces overall stress on the contact zone.
Validation· Load data from force platform measurements of a healthy individual performing static and dynamic falls.

Motivation· To compare the early bone healing performance of a strontium-releasing Ti-Sr-O coating with a commercial SLActive surface.
Method· Implants with Ti-Sr-O coating, SLActive, and Grade 4 titanium were inserted into rabbit femoral condyles; histomorphometric analysis was performed at 2 weeks.
Result· Ti-Sr-O coated implants showed significantly higher bone formation and comparable bone-to-implant contact compared to SLActive and Grade 4 titanium.
Validation· In vivo rabbit study with histomorphometry.

Jungtaek Kim, Seungjin Choi 2018-04-01 10.1109/icassp.2018.8462531
单位: Department of Computer Science and Engineering, POSTECH, Korea
通讯: Jungtaek Kim @ Department of Computer Science and Engineering, POSTECH, Korea
相关性: 该论文提出了一种改进贝叶斯优化的聚类引导方法，可迁移至生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
边界: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification beyond UCB, or implant/biomechanics applications.
动机· 提高贝叶斯优化在非光滑目标函数上的性能，避免陷入局部极值。
方法· 对GP后验均值和标准差进行聚类，结合GP-UCB选择下一个采样点。
结果· 在多种函数上减少了陷入局部极值的风险，且无需复杂辅助优化。
验证· 在标准数值测试函数上进行实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To improve Bayesian optimization for objective functions with sharp peaks and valleys, reducing the risk of local optima.
Method· Clustering is applied to the posterior mean and standard deviation from GP regression, then combined with GP-UCB to select the next query point.
Result· The method alleviates entrapment in local extrema across various test functions with minimal auxiliary optimization.
Validation· Validated on standard numerical benchmark functions.

James E. Warner NASA STI Repository (National Aeronautics and Space Administration) 2018-04-01 link
单位: NASA Langley Research Center Hampton, VA United States

相关性: 该论文提供了一种用于不确定性量化的随机降阶模型工具，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的高效随机计算。
边界: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant mechanics, lacks constraint handling or multi-objective optimization, and provides only a simple spring-mass example without biomedical context.
动机· 开发用户友好的随机降阶模型工具以高效进行不确定性量化。
方法· 基于SROM方法，通过Python实现随机变量近似与不确定性传播。
结果· SROMPy能高效近似随机输入并传播不确定性，与蒙特卡洛结果一致。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To develop a user-friendly software package for efficient uncertainty quantification using stochastic reduced order models.
Method· The SROM approach approximates random quantities with low-dimensional discrete representations, enabling non-intrusive propagation through computational models in Python.
Result· SROMPy efficiently approximates random inputs and propagates uncertainty, yielding statistics comparable to Monte Carlo simulation with reduced computational cost.
Validation· Validation is performed on a spring-mass system with random input, comparing SROM results to classical Monte Carlo simulation.
